item.title: Julian Dennison marries Christian Baledrokadroka in private ceremony
item.description: NAWWW!!! Julian Dennison has married Christian Baledrokadroka after a six-month engagement. The Hunt for the Wilderpeople star shared pictures with his new wife on Instagram, announcing the pair had tied the knot in a private ceremony in an undisclosed New Zealand venue. He simply captured the black and white photo “Forever x”. Baledrokadroka wore a dress from Hera Couture by Katie Yeung, a New Zealand bridal label, and a lengthy draped veil.
